description: Database view exposing project dash board analysis data.
business_purpose: Used to track and report project dash board analysis records, including amounts and quantities, for the Sales & CRM area.
record_granularity: One row represents one record returned by the project dash board analysis view.

columns.description: Name of the project.

columns.name: created_date

columns.description: Name of the area.

business_rules: is_closed = 1 marks the record as closed.
created_date is the preferred date column for period-based reporting.
Use sheet_count for monetary or quantity totals.
Columns role_level, Project_Status, building_status classify the record; check the distinct values before filtering on them.
Vw_ProjectDashBoardAnalysis is a database view: it is read-only and its rows are computed, so apply filters and a LIMIT when querying.
common_queries: Project Dash Board Analysis by month
Project Dash Board Analysis count by role level

known_issues: sheet_count is nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.
Views expose no primary key or nullability guarantees; rows may repeat depending on the view definition.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name Vw_ProjectDashBoardAnalysis (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use SUM(sheet_count) for totals of sheet count.
This is a view; always apply filters and a LIMIT, as it may be expensive to scan.
